tasks.description: Initialize TypeScript Project - Configure tsconfig.json for strict mode, ES2020 target, multiple outputs (ESM, CJS, UMD)
Define Core Type Interfaces - Create src/core/types.ts with TypeDef, Param, Signature, ConversionDef, Type, SignatureFunction, TypedFunction interfaces
Create Type Registry Class - Implement src/core/type-registry.ts with Map-based type storage, addTypes(), findType(), getTypeMask(), clear() methods
Configure ESBuild/Rollup Pipeline - Set up modern build with tree-shaking, source maps, ESM/CJS/UMD/IIFE outputs
Set Up AssemblyScript Toolchain - Install assemblyscript, create assembly directory structure, configure asconfig.json with optimization flags
Create Utility Functions Module - Port initial(), last(), slice(), flatMap() to TypeScript with proper generics
Port isPlainObject and Type Tests - Create src/utils/object-helpers.ts with isPlainObject and builtinTypeTests array for 10 built-in types
Create Error Factory Module - Port createError() to src/core/error-factory.ts with TypedError interface containing category, fn, index, actual, expected data
Set Up Test Infrastructure - Configure Vitest for TypeScript tests, create test utilities createTestTyped() and assertSignatureMatch()
Create CI/CD Pipeline Update - Update GitHub Actions for TypeScript + WASM build, add tsc --noEmit type check, test matrix for Node 18/20/22
